unresolved.reason: NIA's current tourism routes treat Mainland Area people through purpose-, residency-, travel-document-, travel-agency- and permit-conditioned entry-and-exit permits. They do not establish a general foreign ordinary-passport visa or ETA status for the CN code, so it remains unresolved.

BOCA's foreign-passport statute applies to foreign passports; the reviewed current primary sources do not establish acceptance or recognition of a Palestinian ordinary passport or travel document. Its treatment is not inferred from the generic visa default.
